# Runtime test fixtures

These 19 BDDL files are fixed unit-test inputs from the repository revision and
paths recorded in `SOURCE.json`. They replace a dependency on a local desktop
export. Their parameters exercise historical runtime behavior and do not define
the current benchmark.

The published evaluation tasks remain in `assets/bddl/libero-pro2.0-1680-v1/`,
validated against `assets/task_manifest.json`. Do not include these fixtures in
an evaluation plan or regenerate them when refreshing the published catalogue.
